name: tree
description: Draws the contents of a directory and its subdirectories as a tree, then the total number of folders and files. Very handy for seeing the structure of a project. tree is not always installed by default (sudo apt install tree).

options.description: Shows the size of each file in readable units.
Shows the full path of each file.
Excludes files matching the pattern; separate several patterns with | (e.g. 'node_modules|dist').
Shows only files matching the pattern.

arguments.name: DIRECTORY
arguments.description: Root of the tree. Default: the current directory.

examples.explanation: The first two levels of the project directory.
examples.output:
project
├── README.md
├── package.json
└── src
    ├── App.tsx
    └── main.tsx

2 directories, 4 files

examples.explanation: The tree of a web project without the generated folders, directories first.
